definitions.explanation: an organizational unit within a company or institution

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{部署|ぶしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{異動|いどう}→異動：01818_idou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{案件|あんけん}→案件：13109_anken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧{部署|ぶしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

notes:
{部署|ぶしょ} refers to an organizational unit within a company or institution — a department, division, or assigned post.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {部署|ぶしょ}{異動|いどう}: department transfer
- {部署|ぶしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{移|うつ}る→移る：01232_utsuru⟧: to move to another department
- ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧{部署|ぶしょ}: each department
- {担当|たんとう}{部署|ぶしょ}: department in charge
- ⟦{配属|はいぞく}→配属：06159_haizoku⟧{部署|ぶしょ}: assigned department

COMPARISON OF ORGANIZATIONAL TERMS:
- {部署|ぶしょ}: organizational section, post (general)
- ⟦{部門|ぶもん}→部門：14406_bumon⟧: division, field (broader scope)
- ⟦{課|か}→課：01548_ka⟧: section (smaller unit within a ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧)
- ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧: department (larger unit)
- ⟦{係|かかり}→係：02552_kakari⟧: unit, person in charge (smallest unit)

REGISTER:
Used in business and organizational contexts. Commonly heard in workplace conversations about transfers and responsibilities.
